title: WorkspaceRevision
description: Immutable repository identity and exact object binding established only by a successful deterministic result.

repository.description: Canonical repository identity for the selected workspace revision.

provider.description: Provider kind for the repository identity.

url.description: Service URL used to distinguish hosts when required.

project.description: Azure DevOps project containing the repository.

name.description: Repository name, excluding any branch or checkout policy.

id.description: Provider-native repository identifier, if the provider exposes one.

commitSha.description: Full lowercase Git object ID for the selected revision.

sourceRef.description: Optional source ref provenance for the selected revision.

sourceId.description: Optional source identifier provenance for the selected revision.

baseRepository.description: Optional canonical base repository identity that the selected revision is bound to.

baseSha.description: Optional full lowercase Git object ID for the base revision.

sha.description: A full lowercase Git SHA-1 or SHA-256 object ID.
